parameters.content:
## Milestone 1 - Task 6: Jira Agent

Consumes the Report Contract produced by 06-documentation-agent (docs/contracts/report-contract.md) - never a Decision Contract directly - and produces a Jira Draft Contract (docs/contracts/jira-draft-contract.md). No AI call, no direct Jira API call anywhere in this file - every field is either carried forward unchanged or built via a fixed, deterministic template/lookup table, exactly like the Documentation Agent (06) and Excel Writer (06.1) before it.

Drafts are built only for FAIL (always) and MANUAL_REVIEW (configurable, off by default - see 'Build Jira Draft Contract'). PASS and BLOCKED never produce a draft - `jira.required` is `false` and every other `jira.*` field is null/empty, never fabricated.

## Architecture (Task 6 brief)

```
Report Contract
      |
      v
Jira Agent          <- 'Validate Contract' + 'Build Jira Draft Contract'
      |
      v
Jira Draft Contract
      |
      v
Duplicate Check      <- 'Duplicate Check (Extension Point)': architecture
      |                    only for Milestone 1, see its own notes
      v
Draft Ticket         <- 'Draft Ticket': not-yet-built hand-off
      |
      v
Human Approval       <- 'Human Approval': not-yet-built hand-off
      |
      v
Create / Update Jira <- 'Create / Update Jira': not-yet-built hand-off,
                          this is the one point a real Jira API call
                          would ever be made - never in this workflow
```

Every stage from 'Duplicate Check' onward is a NoOp placeholder with a documented contract for what a future task implements there - this workflow's own job stops at producing a correct Jira Draft Contract. No Jira issue is ever created by this file (constraint: 'No Jira API').

## Design notes

- Every `jira.*` field is reused verbatim from the Report Contract (test_case.description/expected_result/steps, report.reasoning/actual_result/manual_review, decision.verdict.evidence) or built via a fixed lookup table (labels, components) / a direct re-read of an already-computed decision (priority from decision.verdict.next_action) - never a new judgment. 'priority' deliberately reuses `next_action` (create_jira -> High, flag_for_review -> Medium) instead of re-deriving a confidence threshold, per docs/workflow-standards.md's 'nothing downstream re-derives a value another workflow already computed' rule - that threshold was already decided once, in 05-decision-orchestrator.json's Apply Trust Rules.
- `report` inside the Jira Draft Contract preserves the ENTIRE validated Report Contract, unchanged - not a subset - so `report.test_case`, `report.decision`, `report.report` all remain reachable for full traceability, and this workflow can truthfully claim it never modifies the Report Contract it received (it only ever reads from a copy of it).
- DRAFT_ON_MANUAL_REVIEW is a single named constant at the top of 'Build Jira Draft Contract' - the one config point Task 6's brief calls for ('MANUAL_REVIEW optional, configurable'). Flipping it is a one-line change, not a workflow redesign.

nodes.name: Duplicate Check (Extension Point)
nodes.notes: Architecture-only for Milestone 1 (Task 6 brief: 'No real Jira API call is required'). Passes every Jira Draft Contract through unchanged. Future extension point: query the Jira API for an existing open issue labeled with this item's report.test_case.test_id; if found, this stage would set an additional field (e.g. jira.duplicate_of) and 'Draft Ticket' would add a comment to that issue instead of drafting a new one - docs/architecture/milestone-1.md section 5's 'Jira Agent' row already specifies this exact behavior. Adding it later is additive to the Jira Draft Contract, not a redesign of this workflow.

nodes.name: Draft Ticket
nodes.notes: Hand-off boundary, not yet built (Task 6+). Receives a Jira Draft Contract with jira.required === true. A future task renders this into whatever a human approval queue needs to see (a Slack message, an n8n manual-approval node, a review UI) - still no Jira API call happens here.

nodes.name: Human Approval
nodes.notes: Hand-off boundary, not yet built (Task 6+). Milestone 1's human-gate requirement (docs/architecture/milestone-1.md: 'Do not automatically create Jira issues' / 'Auto-approval of Jira tickets - stays human-gated'). A draft only ever proceeds past this point on an explicit approval signal.

nodes.name: Create / Update Jira
nodes.notes: Hand-off boundary, not yet built (Task 6+ - constraint: 'No Jira API' for this task). The one point in the whole Jira Layer a real Jira API call would ever be made - create_ticket for a new draft, or update/comment for a Duplicate Check match. Never called from 07-jira-agent.json itself.

nodes.name: No Draft Required
nodes.notes: The expected, normal terminal state for a PASS or BLOCKED report, or a MANUAL_REVIEW report while DRAFT_ON_MANUAL_REVIEW is off. jira.required is false; no ticket is drafted, reviewed, or created for this test case.

nodes.name: Jira Layer Complete
nodes.notes: Terminal node. Every path - a validation ERROR payload, a completed (but not yet API-called) draft, or a no-draft-required item - converges here. This workflow has no consumer of its own.
